summary: v48c bug-fix regression pass — all 4 targeted bugs (BUG 2, 3, 5, 6) verified fixed in preview. Backend pytest 2/2 pass; frontend Playwright verifications 4/4 pass. Regressions: Option E toggle still works; no new JS runtime errors introduced by the fixes.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'Bidding ops' loads the BiddingOpsPanel (verified) but the browser URL is NOT updated to include ?tab=bidding — remains /admin. Review request specified 'expect URL to include tab=bidding'. Functionally OK (state-based routing), but a deep-link/bookmark for tab=bidding won't be created by the click. Deep-link works when arrived via ?tab=bidding in URL. Low priority — cosmetic.
